# "Start new game" never abandons (spec 02 §7.4, D16): the running game is paused – or discarded
# without goals – and the table goes to the kickoff countdown with the current registrations.
next official
start official
start short                   # nobody scored: the first game is discarded
expect deleted 1
expect phase idle             # nobody is registered: no countdown
start short                   # "Start now"
expect phase playing
sensor home_goal
expect score 0:1
start official                # someone scored: the second game is paused
expect status 2 paused
expect reason 2 new_game
expect recent 2
expect phase idle
start official
expect status 3 active
expect score 0:0
restart
expect score 0:0              # the running game comes back, the paused one stays in the list
expect recent 2

# With players registered, "Start new game" goes to the countdown.
add home 7
add away 3
expect phase playing
start official                # game 3 has no goals: discarded
expect deleted 3
expect phase pregame
expect kickoff 5s
wait 5s
expect phase playing
expect roster home=7,_ away=3,_

# Starting after a finished game, during the hold: at once.
plus home
plus home
plus home
plus home
plus home
expect winner home
start official
expect phase playing
expect score 0:0
